summary: Swimmer reported missing off the north shore of Lake Pueblo State Park; CPW rangers and Pueblo County Sheriff's Office divers conducted a ~3-hour grid search with sonar and an underwater ROV and recovered the body ~75 ft from shore in ~6 ft of water near Sailboard Beach; turned over to the Pueblo County Coroner.
location: Lake Pueblo State Park, north shore / Sailboard Beach
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Pueblo County Sheriff's Office divers
notes: Victim identity not published in the article; 8:15 p.m. call Saturday June 15, body located ~11 p.m.
